loadOrder.name: Vanilla Books Expanded
loadOrder.notes: Added to work around a Medieval Overhaul bug: Medieval Overhaul's own Patches/Vanilla Books Expanded/BookPatches.xml adds a DankPyon_Library RoomRoleDef with a relatedStats entry (ReadingBonus, a StatDef only Vanilla Books Expanded defines) ONLY when Vanilla Books Expanded is NOT detected -- that fallback branch is what crashed MedievalOverhaul.Utility's static constructor. Installing the real mod makes Medieval Overhaul's PatchOperationFindMod take its normal match branch instead.

loadOrder.notes: Verified present locally; provides DankPyon_Palisade (wooden palisade wall def) used by the village generator.
